note: Portable default chrome rules for UC San Diego Decorator 5. These pin structure only — no ids, no site-specific URLs, no scope option values — so they hold for any Decorator site. The one deliberate exception is site-title.branding's equalsUrl on the UC San Diego logo link: https://www.ucsd.edu is not a per-site value, it is the same fixed destination on every Decorator template, so pinning it does not break portability the way pinning a site's own title-header href would. Add site-specific rules in a local overlay. Validate against contracts/chrome-selectors.schema.json.

derivedFrom.note: Rules were first derived from Decorator-V5.zip (pinned 2026-07-22) and re-verified 2026-08 against ucsd-decorator-v5@5.0.4, which is now the source of truth. Every marker these rules pin — .search-content, .search-scope, button.navbar-toggle, .mobile-nav-bars, three span.icon-bar, .mobile-nav-icon, the offcanvas drawer, .layout-title — occurs the same number of times in both templates, so the rules are unchanged by the switch. The archive is no longer read: it is behind the package on every file it ships. Re-verified 2026-08-19 against a fresh pin of ucsd-decorator-v5@5.0.4 to add site-title.branding's href check and footer.branding: a.title-logo's href is https://www.ucsd.edu on all 11 shipped templates, and ul.footer-links / img.footer-logo appear identically in each. (In the course of that check, contracts/chrome-regions.json's skip-link selector was found not to match any shipped template — tracked separately, not fixed here.)

forbid.reason: the drawer search must submit a form; a link to the search page loses the scope selector and the typed query

rules.remedy: Restore the drawer search form from the vendor template. See skills/ucsd-decorator/references/protected-regions.md.

forbid.reason: the desktop search must submit a form, not link away

rules.remedy: Restore the desktop search form from the vendor template.
The MENU label and the three bars live inside the toggle button, not beside it.

The title band carries the long and short site title links plus the UC San Diego logo link, which always points to https://www.ucsd.edu on every Decorator site. A different destination — including a mascot page, a custom brand, or another domain — means the logo link was swapped.
The footer carries a footer-links list and the white UC San Diego wordmark image.
